text:
AT&T Stadium daa mu wɔ May 27, 2009 wɔ ne din a edi kan, Cowboys Stadium, Dallas Cowboys a wɔ NFL no foforo fie. HKS, Inc. na ɛyɛɛ no, na ɛyɛɛ no wɔ sika bɛyɛ $1.3 billion, na wɔyɛɛ no kɛseɛ, na ɛbɛyɛɛ NFL stadium a ɛso paa wɔ seating capacity mu. N'akyi sɛ 80,000 nnoɔma a wɔtumi sesa no ma ɛkɔ 100,000 akyi, na ɛwɔ nnoɔma mmienu a ɛda no adi: retractable roof ne video boards a ɛso paa wɔ agorɔ nyinaa mu.

Beaeɛ no nyaa ne din a ɛtena hɔ daa wɔ 2013, bere a wɔde naming-rights deal a wɔde too dwa wɔ July 25 no bɛyɛɛ AT&T Stadium. Efi mfiase no, ɛnyɛ football field nko ara na ɛyɛɛ. Wɔ February 2011 mu no, ɛhyɛɛ Super Bowl XLV no, na mfeɛ no mu no, ɛagye nneɛma akɛseɛ a ɛfiri American football akyi no, na ɛyɛɛ beaeɛ a ɛda adi wɔ ɔman no mu.

Nea ɛho hia paa ne sɛ, stadium no nyaa international football ho nidi. Ɛbɛyɛɛ Concacaf Gold Cup matches ne, wɔ 2024 mu no, Copa América beaeɛ, na ɛyɛɛ neutral ground ma continental competition a ɛkɔ sorɔ. Saa nidi no na ɛde no kɔɔ ne stage a ɛso paa. Wɔ 2026 World Cup no, FIFA too beaeɛ no edin Dallas Stadium na wɔsesaa no yɛɛ natural-grass pitch a wɔma no kɛseɛ na wɔtrɛ no ma ɛkɔ tournament dimensions, na saa nsakraeɛ no maa gridiron showpiece no bɛyɛɛ global football arena.
